## Checklist

- [ ] Project is open source with a clear license (SPDX identifier given)
- [ ] URL works (returns 2xx) and points to the canonical home
- [ ] Last commit / release within the past 2 years OR project is foundational and clearly still in use
- [ ] Description is one sentence, neutral tone, no marketing language
- [ ] Entry is in the correct category file under `docs/`
- [ ] If applicable, MCP-wrap badge correctly set (green if wrapped by mcp-eda-server, gray + "contribution wanted" otherwise)
- [ ] `awesome-lint` passes locally (`npx awesome-lint`)
